name: StockWatchIndex
imageAlt: StockWatchIndex website shown on a desktop display
body: StockWatchIndex has been a valued client for over five years. When we first connected, their site had an outdated logo and limited functionality. We started by rebranding their identity with a modern logo that better reflected the forward-thinking voice of the site’s owner — an experienced entrepreneur with deep roots in the cannabis, crypto, and tech industries.

Since then, we’ve built StockWatchIndex into a powerful publishing platform that delivers real-time financial news, stock updates, and in-depth analysis across crypto, cannabis, and real estate markets. The website features custom article posting tools, integrated RSS feeds, subscription capture forms, and an SEO-optimized structure to ensure visibility and reach.
Now a trusted source for thousands of investors, StockWatchIndex continues to grow, and we remain their dedicated partner for hosting, support, and digital expansion.
result: Accumulated over 58k newsletter subscribers since the revamp.
